name: Rising
audio: a low bubbling swamp, a slow sinister swell and croaking frogs; no speech
world: The bog is alive: luminous green fumes drift, bubbles burst, giant fungus lamps pulse, frogs and moths lift out of the mist and glowing spores float through the air.

actions.beat: The bog bubbles and releases luminous green fumes, giant fungus lamps pulsing, frogs and moths lifting out of the mist.
{{She}} rises with unhurried, almost lazy grace out of the bubbling mire, one hand lifted with fingers spread, the other trailing.
Glowing venom drips from {{her}} gown and falls slowly back into the bog as {{her}} eyes ignite with {{MAGIC}} light and {{she}} meets the camera with a slow, knowing smile.

notes: THE DAWN, in motion: the sister rises from the Sundering in her homeland, the world moving around her.
